The order for the Soy Candle Trio was shipped to the buyer's verified PayPal address on 2026-11-09 via USPS tracking number 9400111899223344550011. The package was successfully delivered on 2026-11-09 at 22:40:00Z, and we have provided a delivery photo taken at the front door of the address provided in the transaction. Furthermore, this buyer has a history of two previous successful and undisputed orders with Fernhill Goods, both shipped to the same address on 2026-08-14 and 2026-10-02. Given the consistent shipping history and the confirmed delivery to the verified address, we respectfully request that this claim be denied and the funds released to our account. Fernhill Goods
